description: The live rank of one of your apps for any search term in one storefront, as the store shows it right now — the term does not need to be tracked. The state keeps the cases apart: `ranked` with the rank and the apps just above, `absent` with the top results (the app is sold there and sits outside those results), `not_in_store` (the app is not sold in that storefront).

app.description: App Store link or id, or Google Play link or package name

platform.description: optional; read from the app link

name: check_rank
